a.lede: Two gaming PCs capable of 1080p gameplay have dropped below $1,000, a price that's hard to beat in the current market, thanks to sales at Best Buy and Walmart.
a.title: Score a 1080p gaming PC for less than $1,000 right now, fitted with Nvidia or AMD GPUs

b.lede: PC shipments for the third quarter of 2026 drop by 15.8 million units, with Lenovo, HP, and Dell being hit the hardest. Memory chip manufacturers estimate that the situation will not improve until 2028 or 2029, even as Acer believes that PC prices will decline by late 2027.
b.title: PC shipments tumble over 20% in 3Q26 as chip shortages bite
